types.name: name
types.definition: Personal name of a natural person (patient, employee, contractor, or named provider).

types.name: date_of_birth
types.definition: A person's date of birth, in any format.

types.name: ssn
types.definition: Social Security Number, whole or partially masked.

types.name: home_address
types.definition: Residential street address of a person. Excludes the clinic's own premises address.

types.name: emergency_contact
types.definition: The subject's designated emergency or guardian contact — the identity of the person the subject nominated, with or without a phone number. This is an attribute OF THE SUBJECT: under HIPAA the emergency contact recorded in a patient record forms part of the designated record set, and is therefore PHI about the patient. Who the subject designated is a relational fact about the subject, not merely a record about the contact. Always subject-linked; see SUBJECT_LINKED_BY_DEFINITION.

types.name: medical_diagnosis
types.definition: A current or working clinical diagnosis, stated in words or encoded as a diagnostic code.

types.name: medical_medication
types.definition: A prescribed or administered drug, typically with dose and frequency.

types.name: medical_history
types.definition: Past conditions, procedures, or clinical events, as distinct from the current presenting diagnosis.

types.name: mental_health
types.definition: Psychiatric or substance-use diagnosis, assessment instrument score, or treatment detail. The extra-sensitive subset of the clinical family.

types.name: billing_code
types.definition: A procedure or diagnosis code used for billing — CPT, HCPCS, or ICD-10.

types.name: insurance_info
types.definition: Payer identity, plan type, and/or member, policy, or group identifier.

types.name: salary
types.definition: An individual's compensation figure — annual salary, base pay, or contractor hourly rate.

types.name: employment_contract
types.definition: The existence, identifier, or terms of an employment agreement.

types.name: contract_terms
types.definition: Terms of a non-employee contractor engagement — scope, rate, restrictions.
examples: IT infrastructure support; $88/hr; no PHI access permitted

types.name: job_title
types.definition: A person's occupational role or position within the organization.

types.name: medical_license
types.definition: A clinician credential identifier — state medical license, NPI, or DEA registration number.
